summary: Real-case regression of expression level for engineered α-amylase variants.
what_it_measures: Standardized expression level (`expression_standardized`) across α-amylase variants; how well each variant is produced.
assay_method: Experimental expression measurements on α-amylase variants in the Protein Engineering Tournament.
provenance: A 'real_case' α-amylase dataset from the Align Foundation tournament; one random split, stratified on the target.
when_to_use: Applied expressibility ranking within one enzyme family; useful for pre-screening variants for producibility.
caveats: Small, single-scaffold campaign; the tournament noted expression-control comparability issues. one random split, stratified on the target; standardized target.

citations.authors: The Protein Engineering Tournament (Align to Innovate)
citations.title: Results of the Protein Engineering Tournament: An Open Science Benchmark for Protein Modeling and Design
